title: The God Who Sees
body: Hagar, alone in the wilderness, named God 'El Roi' — the God who sees me. Whatever you feel unseen in today, you are not hidden from Him.

title: Manna for Today
body: God gave Israel manna one day at a time — never enough to hoard, always enough to trust. Today's provision is enough for today's need.

title: A Still Small Voice
body: Elijah expected God in the wind and the fire, but found Him in a whisper. Sometimes God speaks loudest in the quiet.

title: The Potter's Hands
body: Jeremiah watched a potter reshape flawed clay rather than discard it. God is still shaping, not discarding, you.

title: New Every Morning
body: Even in the middle of loss, Jeremiah remembered that God's mercies are new every morning. Whatever yesterday held, today is fresh.

title: The Vine and the Branches
body: Jesus said apart from Him we can do nothing — not because we're incapable, but because fruit only grows while attached to the vine.

title: Fear Not, Little Flock
body: Jesus called His followers a 'little flock' and told them not to fear, because the Father was pleased to give them the kingdom.

title: A Living Hope
body: Peter wrote to a scattered, suffering church about a living hope through the resurrection — hope that outlasts hardship.
